title: Rationalizing collective revealed preferences with an application in fair resource allocation
summary: This paper presents a revealed preference approach for rationalizing collective consumption behavior. We introduce the Constructive Rationalization Method (CRM), which approximates the real market via a surrogate market of artificial consumers, called androids, with easy-to-compute demand functions. CRM uses observed aggregate demand and adds artificial consumers on the fly, while redistributing wealth under an empirical risk minimization principle.
